Exactly eight full-body poses, arranged 4 columns by 2 rows, on perfectly flat #FF00FF pure magenta. Hold the matchlock at a steady ready carry angle; do not aim, fire, add muzzle flash, smoke, sparks, effects, or recoil. No text, labels, grid, borders, shadows or scenery. Make a clear grounded walk cycle: frame 1 right-foot-forward contact; 2 weight transfer; 3 left foot passing; 4 left foot swinging forward; frame 5 opposite contact with left foot forward/right foot back; 6 weight transfer; 7 right foot passing; 8 right foot swinging into frame 1. Clearly alternate support legs between frames 1 and 5. Keep torso and gun guard steady. Same anatomy, armor and body scale in all panels. Keep helmet crest, mantle, hands, matchlock and feet fully inside each invisible cell and leave clear gaps between poses.
